# The Oberdorfer Team

> A husband-and-wife real estate team led by Brandon and Kaitlyn Oberdorfer. The team works from Worcester, Massachusetts, serves buyers and sellers across the state, and operates under REWAP Brokerage LLC. Phone: 406-250-7620. Promise: "Luxury at every price point."

Facts on this site are sourced and dated. Town market figures are calendar-year 2025 single-family sales and medians from The Warren Group (MA December 2025 Sales, Prices by Town). The Wakefield snapshot is from Redfin, accessed October 10, 2026. None of the figures are live. Community guides describe places, housing, transit and history; school information is limited to links to each district's Massachusetts DESE profile. Listings on this prototype are demonstrations.

## People
- [Brandon Oberdorfer](https://oberdorferteam.com/agents/brandon-oberdorfer/): Team leader, The Oberdorfer Team. Leads the team with his wife, Kaitlyn Oberdorfer.
- [Kaitlyn Oberdorfer](https://oberdorferteam.com/agents/kaitlyn-oberdorfer/): Team leader, The Oberdorfer Team. Leads the team with her husband, Brandon Oberdorfer.
